**Why the coverage was added:** The 401 fallback in `openmrsFetch` (use the configured URL, else the response's `Location` header, else the default login page) shipped in O3-4897 (#1430, commit e31fe71d) with no tests for the Location and default branches. Commit e16e2d9e (#1754) is titled "Add regression tests for 401 Location-header redirect in openmrsFetch." I could not read the PR description, so the motive comes from that title and the diff, not from a stated rationale.

**What the new tests pin down** (all in `openmrs-fetch.test.ts`, added by e16e2d9e):
- A 401 with a `Location` header navigates to that header's URL (`/module/authentication/login.form`), and the test checks the first navigate call. This is the auth-module challenge case.
- A 401 with no `Location` header navigates to the default login route `${openmrsSpaBase}/login`. This is the genuine-failure case. The expected value is a single-quoted literal, so the test asserts that exact string rather than an interpolated URL.
- When `redirectAuthFailure.url` is set, a 401 navigates to that configured URL. This test was already present and was not added by #1754.
- With `rejectAuthFailure: true`, a 401 navigates to login and still rejects with `OpenmrsFetchError`. This also predates #1754.

**Which change and ticket:** The behavior is from O3-4897 (e31fe71d). The regression tests came from #1754 (e16e2d9e), and that commit's message names no ticket. Falkon has no PR tool, so I could not confirm whether #1754's description references a ticket.

Related but separate: 9dae818f (O3-5767, #1797) added the `Location` redirect on 2xx session responses and 204s. The 401 path under review is not part of that change.

**Evidence, best first:**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/openmrs-fetch.ts:226-243` — 401 handling: config-gated redirect, clearHistory, fallback chain, and resolve/reject behavior.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/openmrs-fetch.ts:234` — the `url || location header || defaultRedirectAuthFailureUrl` fallback.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/openmrs-fetch.test.ts:166-185` — 401 with Location header test.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/openmrs-fetch.test.ts:197-214` — 401 without Location header test.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/openmrs-fetch.test.ts:216-233` — configured-URL test.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/openmrs-fetch.test.ts:235-243` — rejectAuthFailure test.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/openmrs-fetch.ts:189-195` — Location redirect on 2xx session/204 (related, from O3-5767).
